name: BBSC - Bloodborne Seamless Co-op
author: CLS_AMG; seamless summon by Wozzardman; server format by fhody125
description: One co-op session across areas, deaths, lamps, bosses and the Hunter's Dream. Bloodborne CUSA03173 v1.09 only. Warps and world sync go through the host's game server relay (port 20444). Off = the vanilla online game.

settings.name: Seamless summon
settings.description: Summon without the vanilla signs and waits (Wozzardman)

settings.name: Co-op hooks
settings.description: Warps, world sync, Hunter's Dream, messages... (most features below need this)

settings.name: Cross-map summon
settings.description: Join first, then one load into the host's map

settings.name: Warp together
settings.description: The guest follows the host through lamp warps

settings.name: World sync
settings.description: The guest sees the host's world state (doors, bosses, lifts)

settings.name: Hunter's Dream together
settings.description: The guest uses the Doll, workshop and messengers

settings.name: No co-op fog walls
settings.description: Leaving the area is allowed

settings.name: Lamps in co-op
settings.description: The host can use lamps during a session

settings.name: Stay when the host dies
settings.description: The guest keeps the session if the host dies

settings.name: Respawn in place
settings.description: A dead player respawns / spectates instead of leaving

settings.name: Revive
settings.description: A fallen hunter waits where it fell; another one revives it by holding X beside it for 15 s

settings.name: Full echoes
settings.description: A guest is paid the host's rate, not half

settings.name: No guest HP cut
settings.description: Removes the summoned guest's 30% max HP cut

settings.name: Guest items
settings.description: A guest picks up and keeps items

settings.name: Solid NPCs
settings.description: A guest sees NPCs solid, not as grey ghosts

settings.name: Bloodstain on death
settings.description: A kept death still drops a bloodstain and echoes

settings.name: Free Beckoning Bell
settings.description: The bell costs no Insight

settings.name: Bells anywhere
settings.description: The kit's bells ring anywhere, the Hunter's Dream included (your role, Insight and being online still count)

settings.name: Five hunters
settings.description: The host may summon up to 4 guests

settings.name: Co-op texts
settings.description: Texts that fit seamless play (no "Returning to your world")

settings.name: Black fade on joins
settings.description: The guest's loads happen behind a black fade

settings.name: Floor guard
settings.description: No crash when a character's floor was unloaded

settings.name: Enemy scaling
settings.description: Enemies and bosses get stronger for every guest (replaces the game's own boss buff)

settings.name: Scale NPC hunters
settings.description: Henryk, Djura and the other hostile hunters also get the enemy scaling (off = vanilla)

settings.name: Enemy HP per guest (%)
settings.description: Extra health for normal enemies, per guest

settings.name: Boss HP per guest (%)
settings.description: Extra health for bosses, per guest

settings.name: Enemy damage per guest (%)
settings.description: Extra damage for enemies and bosses, per guest

settings.name: Enemy stagger resistance per guest (%)
settings.description: Harder to stagger normal enemies, per guest

settings.name: Boss stagger resistance per guest (%)
settings.description: Harder to stagger bosses, per guest

settings.name: Shared progress
settings.description: When a guest goes home, bosses, shortcuts, doors and lamps the host has done are added to the guest's own world (adds only, never removes; NPC quests and your character are not touched; saves backed up first)

settings.name: Discord status
settings.description: Shows BBSC, your area, your build, boss fights with a timer, when you are dead or spectating, and the number of hunters on your Discord profile

settings.name: P2P channel
settings.description: Sends BBSC's own messages (follow, world sync, scaling, leaving) straight to the other players over the game's own connection when there is no BBSC relay - needed on public servers (The Hunter's Dream)

settings.name: Relay address
settings.description: host:20444 - leave empty to use the game server address from host_overrides.json (JOIN-HOST sets it)
